subject: Clearline marketplace commit: MAP, evaluation milestones & billing routing
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Margaret Lin <margaret.lin@clearline.com>, Procurement <procurement@clearline.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Aug 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Draft MAP & high-level evaluation window for Clearline marketplace commit

Hi Margaret / Clearline procurement team,

Following our call last week, attached is a concise mutual action plan (MAP) to get the Clearline private offer through marketplace acceptance (AWS + GCP + Azure), technical evaluation, and invoice routing. This is an initial draft — I’ve kept the milestones tight so we can lock dates quickly.

Top-level summary:
- Goal: Private offer signed and marketplace acceptance completed by 2027-09-15.
- Technical evaluation window: 2027-09-01 -> 2027-09-08 (integration + perf tests).
- Billing route: Clearline prefers consolidated monthly invoice via procurement@clearline.com; we map to AWS private offer settlement unless legal requests otherwise.

Action items I suggest we own:
1) Clearline: finalize procurement contact for invoice (name + billing address) — procurement@clearline.com OK?
2) Redwood (Aditya): prep the env for perf tests (GPU config + sample dataset).
3) Redwood (Kimberly): coordinate marketplace listing acceptance checklist with Marketplace teams and provide the acceptance gates doc.
4) Mutual: sign DocuSign terms (I’ll circulate) and complete SOC2 questionnaire by 2027-09-03.

Attachments: clearline_map_v2.xlsx (MAP with milestones), clearline_evaluation_tests.pdf (test plan).

If this looks good I’ll push a refreshed MAP with dates locked and send the DocuSign link.

Thanks,

Priyom Das
Senior Sales, Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwoodinference.com
[Attachment: clearline_map_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

From: Margaret Lin <margaret.lin@clearline.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@clearline.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2027 10:22:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Draft MAP & high-level evaluation window for Clearline marketplace commit

Hi Priyom — thanks for the quick turnaround and the clear summary.

Procurement confirms procurement@clearline.com is the right inbox; I’ll follow up separately with the billing address and PO cadence (we typically prefer net-30 consolidated invoices). A couple notes from our side:

- We can lock the technical evaluation for 2027-09-01 to 09-08. Please include a light-weight checklist for our infra (VPC peering, egress rules).
- Legal will need a copy of the commercial terms before DocuSign; procurement copies legal on these threads (I’ll loop them in).
- We’d like an acceptance gate that includes a 99th percentile latency test for peak load + a validation run of our PII redaction sample.

I’ll review the MAP spreadsheet later today and share any constraints. For the DocuSign flow: we prefer Redwood to initiate the envelope and set signer order to Clearline procurement -> Clearline legal -> Redwood.

Best,
Margaret
Head of Platform Partnerships, Clearline Systems
[Inline: marginal notes on clearline_map_v2.xlsx]

Margaret — thanks, noted. I updated the MAP to reflect the acceptance gates you requested and included an infra checklist. New file attached (same name, v2). Key changes summarized below:

- Acceptance gates: perf (99th P95/P99), PII redaction verification, and signed data processing addendum (DPA) before invoice activation.
- Evaluation runbook: day-by-day plan for 2027-09-01 -> 09-08 with roles (Redwood infra owners and Clearline app owners).
- DocuSign flow: we’ll start the envelope today and set the signer order exactly as you requested.

Next steps / owners:
- Margaret / Procurement: confirm PO cadence (net-30) and supply billing address by 2027-09-02.
- Aditya (Infra): confirm GPU pool and test dataset readiness by 2027-08-31 EOD.
- Kimberly (Marketplace ops): confirm marketplace acceptance checklist completion ETA 2027-09-06.

I’m attaching clearline_evaluation_tests.pdf (detailed test pass/fail criteria) and will circulate the DocuSign link once legal approves the attached commercial terms.

Thanks — I’ll keep this thread for MAP updates.

Priyom
Senior Sales, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: clearline_evaluation_tests.pdf (pdf)]

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 31 Aug 2027 14:42:00 -0700
Subject: FW: Draft MAP & high-level evaluation window for Clearline marketplace commit

Folks — looping in Redwood legal. A couple of points from our side to speed closing:

1) I’ve attached the v3 commercial terms with two small redlines: (a) payment terms mirrored to net-30; (b) invoice routing clause that defaults to customer-side marketplace invoice unless Clearline requests direct invoicing to procurement mailbox. Please review.
2) We will initiate DocuSign after we have confirmation on the billing address and the PO cadence.
3) Tech acceptance: please ensure the acceptance criteria call out how rollbacks/fallbacks will be handled if perf tests fail (can we add automatic fallback to a lower-concurrency config and a recorded post-mortem within 48 hours?).

I’ll wait for procurement to confirm the billing contact; Priyom — once you have that, I’ll send the DocuSign envelope (docusign_terms_v3.pdf attached).

Irene Choi
Legal Counsel, Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwoodinference.com
[Attachment: docusign_terms_v3.pdf (pdf)]
